mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce discount rates for equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in unemployment rate signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250), a 1-month increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 250 AND FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250 and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 1 month (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1.2 million units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1200 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO has declined over the past 3 months (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A recent increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1pp in 5 days) signals immediate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 5 days (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential mortgage credit and housing starts signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines and HOUST falls (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
